name: Slateport City
lines:
My Pokémon has a Hasty Nature.
And it has a higher Speed stat than my other Pokémon.
Maybe Nature has something to do with how stats grow?

You’ll need a Contest Pass if
you want to enter a contest.
I got mine from the famous
contest star Lisia!

Oh, isn’t that a Contest Pass?
Then I guess that makes us rivals!
